title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: Wednesday, September 9, 2026: Markets Dip Amid Oil Surge and Rate Hike Concerns

items.headline: U.S. Equities Close Lower as Geopolitical Tensions Drive Oil Prices Above $100 and Fuel Rate Hike Expectations.
items.summary: U.S. stock markets finished Wednesday's session in negative territory, driven by renewed inflation concerns as Brent crude oil surged above $100 a barrel following escalating U.S.-Iran tensions. Investors are closely monitoring upcoming inflation data and Federal Reserve announcements, with increasing expectations for a rate hike.

items.headline: NuScale Power Leads Gains
items.summary: NuScale Power ($SMR) closed 16.8% higher, showing strong upward movement.

items.headline: Energy Sector Leads, Financials and Healthcare Lag
items.summary: The Energy Select Sector SPDR (XLE) rose 1% as oil prices surged, making it a leading sector today. Conversely, Financials (XLF) fell 1.4%, Health Care (XLV) declined 2.6%, and Materials (XLB) dropped 0.9%. Industrials and Consumer Cyclicals also experienced significant declines.

items.headline: Fed Meeting Approaches Amid Rising Rate Hike Expectations
items.summary: The Federal Reserve is set to meet on September 15-16. While a majority of economists expect rates to hold steady, the CME FedWatch Tool indicates a 60.4% chance of a 25-basis-point increase, fueled by persistent inflation concerns and surging oil prices. Traders are keenly awaiting the Producer Price Index (PPI) tomorrow and Consumer Price Index (CPI) on Friday.

items.headline: Key Companies Release Q2 Earnings
items.summary: Chewy Inc. ($CHWY) announced strong second-quarter fiscal 2026 financial results, with net sales increasing 7.3%. Core & Main Inc. ($CNM) also reported its second-quarter results, showing a 2.5% increase in net sales. Academy Sports and Outdoors ($ASO) delivered profitable growth with net sales up 3.0% for Q2 fiscal 2026.

items.headline: Oil Prices Breach $100 a Barrel Amid U.S.-Iran Tensions
items.summary: Brent crude oil surpassed $100 per barrel today for the first time since July, rising 2.8% to $100.62. This surge is attributed to escalating U.S.-Iran tensions and renewed fighting near the Strait of Hormuz, intensifying inflation concerns across global markets.

items.headline: Barclays Raises S&P 500 Year-End Target
items.summary: Barclays has raised its year-end target for the S&P 500 index to 7,950 from 7,800, citing a standout earnings season driven by technology companies. The brokerage expects strong earnings momentum to continue, supported by AI investment and healthy economic activity.
